description: Runs cargo clippy and returns structured lint diagnostics.

allTargets.description: Check all targets (lib, bins, tests, benches, examples) (--all-targets)

deny.description: Lint names to set to deny level (-- -D <lint>). Example: ["clippy::unwrap_used"]

features.description: Space or comma separated list of features to activate (--features)

fix.description: Automatically apply clippy suggestions (--fix --allow-dirty). Implies --allow-dirty to work with uncommitted changes.

forbid.description: Lint names to forbid (-- -F <lint>). Cannot be overridden. Example: ["unsafe_code"]

frozen.description: Require Cargo.lock and cache are up to date (--frozen)

locked.description: Require Cargo.lock is up to date (--locked)

noDefaultFeatures.description: Do not activate the default feature (--no-default-features)

noDeps.description: Run clippy only on the specified package, not its dependencies (--no-deps)

package.description: Package to lint in a workspace (-p <SPEC>)

release.description: Run clippy in release mode with optimizations (--release)

warn.description: Lint names to set to warn level (-- -W <lint>). Example: ["clippy::unwrap_used", "clippy::expect_used"]

name: clippy

suggestion.description: Suggested fix text from compiler/clippy children

title: Cargo Clippy
